svg.title: Room to keep moving
svg.desc: Two three-leg detours connect rhythms 2 / 3 to 4 / 7, and 4 / 7 to 6 / 11. The first arm grows to 300 or 700, stays long during the blend, then returns to 245. Five stills show each route at one scale. Gold arcs around halfway through the orbit are magnified below; they can cross themselves. Every drawing has zero net tangent turns and winds once around its center.
svg.text: Lengthen the first arm · blend with it held long · bring it home.
0 net direction turns · +1 around the center
Gold: near the orbit’s halfway point.
Hollow circle: the arc’s ends meet.
The arc can also cross itself.
Both axes use the same scale.

Full drawings share one scale within each row. Lenses fit independently. The exact speed certificates cover the complete routes.
